name: react-ts-vite
description: React + TypeScript + Vite web app with a Node/Express server, npm workspaces (shared / server / web), Vitest-free node:test unit tests and Playwright E2E
standardChecks:
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check`
- `npm test` (unit and integration)
- `npm run build`
- the E2E specs the change touches (`npx playwright test <spec>`); the full suite runs in CI
